arxiv-2205-10238.title: Visualizing and Explaining Language Models
arxiv-2205-10238.creator: Adrian M.P. Braşoveanu, Răzvan Andonie
arxiv-2205-10238.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Adrian M.P. Braşoveanu, Răzvan Andonie. During the last decade, Natural Language Processing has become, after Computer Vision, the second field of Artificial Intelligence that was massively changed by the advent of Deep Learning. Regardless of the architecture, the language models of the day need to be able to process or generate text, as well as predict missing words, sentences or relations depending on the task. Due to their black-box nature, such models are difficult to interpret and explain to third parties.

arxiv-2301-00717.title: Robust Consensus Clustering and its Applications for Advertising Forecasting
arxiv-2301-00717.creator: Deguang Kong, Miao Lu, Konstantin Shmakov, Jian Yang
arxiv-2301-00717.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Deguang Kong, Miao Lu, Konstantin Shmakov, Jian Yang. Consensus clustering aggregates partitions in order to find a better fit by reconciling clustering results from different sources/executions. In practice, there exist noise and outliers in clustering task, which, however, may significantly degrade the performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel algorithm – robust consensus clustering that can find common ground truth among experts’ opinions, which tends to be minimally affected by the bias caused by the outliers.

arxiv-2305-10107.title: Euclid preparation. XXIX. Water ice in spacecraft part I: The physics of ice formation and contamination
arxiv-2305-10107.creator: Euclid Collaboration: M. Schirmer 1, K. Thürmer 2, B. Bras 3, M. Cropper 4, J. Martin-Fleitas 5, Y. Goueffon 6, R. Kohley 7, A. Mora 8, M. Portaluppi 3, G. D. Racca 3, A. D. Short 3, S. Szmolka 3, L. M. Gaspar Venancio 3, M. Altmann 9,10, Z. Balog 9, U. Bastian 9, M. Biermann 9, D. Busonero 11, C. F
arxiv-2305-10107.description: Abstract Material outgassing in a vacuum leads to molecular contamination, a well-known problem in spaceflight. Water is the most common contaminant in cryogenic spacecraft, altering numerous properties of optical systems. Too much ice means that Euclid ’s calibration requirements cannot be met anymore. Euclid must then be thermally decontaminated, which is a month-long risky operation.

arxiv-2306-00835.title: Reconstructing Sea Surface Temperature Images: A Masked Autoencoder Approach for Cloud Masking and Reconstruction
arxiv-2306-00835.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . This thesis presents a new algorithm to mitigate cloud masking in the analysis of sea surface temperature (SST) data generated by remote sensing technologies, e.g., the Level-2 Visible-Infrared Imager-Radiometer Suite (VIIRS). Clouds interfere with the analysis of all remote sensing data using wavelengths shorter than ≈ 12 \approx 12 microns, significantly limiting the quantity of usable data and creating a biased geographical distribution (towards equatorial and coastal regions).

arxiv-2310-20209.title: Network Contention-Aware Cluster Scheduling with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2310-20209.creator: Junyeol Ryu, Jeongyoon Eo
arxiv-2310-20209.description: Abstract With continuous advances in deep learning, distributed training is becoming common in GPU clusters. Specifically, for emerging workloads with diverse amounts, ratios, and patterns of communication, we observe that network contention can significantly degrade training throughput. However, widely used scheduling policies often face limitations as they are agnostic to network contention between jobs.

arxiv-2404-10736.title: On forcing axioms and weakenings of the Axiom of Choice
arxiv-2404-10736.creator: Diego Lima Bomfim, Charles Morgan and Samuel Gomes da Silva
arxiv-2404-10736.description: Abstract . We prove forcing axiom equivalents of two families of weakenings of the axiom of choice: a trichotomy principle for cardinals isolated by Lévy, H κ \mathop{\rm H\hskip 0.05pt}_{\kappa} , and DC κ \mathop{\rm DC}_{\kappa} , the principle of dependent choices generalized to cardinals κ \kappa , for regular cardinals κ \kappa .

arxiv-2407-00662.title: Multi-Agent Training for Pommerman: Curriculum Learning and Population-based Self-Play Approach
arxiv-2407-00662.creator: Nhat-Minh Huynh, Hoang-Giang Cao, I-Chen Wu
arxiv-2407-00662.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nhat-Minh Huynh, Hoang-Giang Cao, I-Chen Wu. Pommerman is a multi-agent environment that has received considerable attention from researchers in recent years. This environment is an ideal benchmark for multi-agent training, providing a battleground for two teams with communication capabilities among allied agents. Pommerman presents significant challenges for model-free reinforcement learning due to delayed action effects, sparse rewards, and false positives, where opponent players can lose due to their own mistakes.

arxiv-2407-08820.title: Matching polytopes, Gorensteinness, and the integer decomposition property
arxiv-2407-08820.creator: Benjamin Eisley, Koji Matsushita, Andrés R. Vindas-Meléndez
arxiv-2407-08820.description: Abstract . The matching polytope of a graph G G is the convex hull of the indicator vectors of the matchings on G G . We characterize the graphs whose associated matching polytopes are Gorenstein, and then prove that all Gorenstein matching polytopes possess the integer decomposition property.

arxiv-2410-08789.title: Conjugating trivial automorphisms of 𝒫 ⁡ ( ℕ ) / fin \mathcal{P}(\mathbb{N})/\mathrm{fin}
arxiv-2410-08789.creator: Will Brian, Ilijas Farah
arxiv-2410-08789.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Will Brian, Ilijas Farah. A trivial automorphism of the Boolean algebra 𝒫 ⁡ ( ℕ ) / Fin \mathcal{P}(\mathbb{N})/\mathrm{Fin} is an automorphism induced by the action of some function ℕ → ℕ \mathbb{N}\rightarrow\mathbb{N} . The forcing axiom 𝖮𝖢𝖠 T \mathsf{OCA}_{\mathrm{T}} implies all automorphisms are trivial, and therefore two trivial automorphisms are conjugate if and only if they have the same (modulo finite) orbit structure.

arxiv-2504-15802.title: Cosmic ray neutrons in magnetized astrophysical structures
arxiv-2504-15802.creator: Ellis R. Owen 1,2, Yoshiyuki Inoue 1,3,4, Tatsuki Fujiwara 1, Qin Han 5 and Kinwah Wu 5,3 1 Theoretical Astrophysics, Department of Earth and Space Science, Graduate School of Science, The University of Osaka, Toyonaka 560-0043, Osaka, Japan 2 Astrophysical Big Bang Laboratory (ABBL), RIKEN Pioneeri
arxiv-2504-15802.description: Abstract Cosmic rays are often modeled as charged particles. This allows their non-ballistic propagation in magnetized structures to be captured. In certain situations, a neutral cosmic ray component can arise. For example, cosmic ray neutrons are produced in considerable numbers through hadronic pp and p γ \gamma interactions.

arxiv-2602-19296.title: A Causal Framework for Estimating Heterogeneous Effects of On-Demand Tutoring
arxiv-2602-19296.creator: Kirk Vanacore, Danielle R Thomas, Digory Smith, Bibi Groot, Justin Reich, Rene Kizilcec
arxiv-2602-19296.description: Abstract This paper introduces a scalable causal inference framework for estimating the immediate, session-level effects of on-demand human tutoring embedded within adaptive learning systems. Because students seek assistance at moments of difficulty, conventional evaluation is confounded by self-selection and time-varying knowledge states.

pmc-11510680.creator: Sarah Damanti, Eleonora Senini, Rebecca De Lorenzo, Aurora Merolla, Simona Santoro, Costanza Festorazzi, Marco Messina, Giordano Vitali, Clara Sciorati, Patrizia Rovere-Querini

pmc-12443958.title: Cerebellar dentate nucleus lesions in monkey reveal both a motor-cognitive dichotomy and within-cognition dichotomy of dorsal vs ventral stream processing
pmc-12443958.creator: Jeremy D Schmahmann, Ronald D Killiany, Mark Vangel, Tara L Moore, Mark B Moss, Douglas L Rosene
pmc-12443958.description: The dysmetria of thought theory holds that the cerebellum is an integral node in the distributed neural circuits subserving cognition. We tested this theory in four rhesus monkeys with bilateral lesions in cerebellar dentate nuclei (DN), targeting ventral sectors linked with cerebral association cortices engaged in cognitive processing. Lesion localization was confirmed by MRI and histology.

pmc-13153650.creator: Tara Ní Néill, Niamh Wilson, Jijo Thomas, Jake McDonnell, Stacey L. Darwish, Joseph S. Butler, Fergal J. O'Brien, James E. Dixon, Caroline M. Curtin, Conor T. Buckley
pmc-13153650.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Intervertebral disc (IVD) degeneration is the predominant cause of low back pain, resulting from progressive extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation and establishment of a pro-catabolic microenvironment. microRNA (miRNA) delivery has potential to promote ECM restoration and curb the catabolic milieu. We previously demonstrated a robust anti-catabolic effect through the delivery of a dual-miRNA injectable therapy in ex vivo organ culture models of degeneration.
